name: Germania
beschreibung:
Excellently located in Ischgl, Hotel Germania welcomes holidaymakers with stylish rooms, relaxing wellness amenities, and exquisite dining. It provides an ideal base for action-packed days in the mountains.

The Silvrettabahn and Fimbabahn cable cars, as well as the bustling village center, are an easy walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Germania in Ischgl provides contemporary comfort and prime proximity to the Silvretta Arena slopes.
